caveats: Most per-plant values are company totals divided by site counts (estimated); plant sizes vary widely (Quanta: 5.7-62.8 MW within one company).
Hon Hai figure is per campus (>230 campuses incl. non-assembly); total derived from green share 68.37%.
Wistron electricity derived from renewable MWh / renewable share of electricity; plant count ~12 is approximate.
Jabil FY24->FY25 decline reflects mobility divestiture, not efficiency.
Quanta 2024 SR (adds US/Mexico/Vietnam/Germany sites) was bot-blocked; 2023 SR data used.
Supermicro, Inventec, Celestica, Pegatron, Flex site-level electricity not retrieved; Flex 2025 report text has no MWh figures.

Type B covers wafer plants (plus an Entegris company total); specialty gases (ASU MW), photoresist (JSR/TOK) and HPQ (Sibelco Spruce Pine, The Quartz Corp) remain null - web search budget exhausted. SUMCO and Shin-Etsu report PDFs could not be text-extracted.

Entegris energy totals are internally inconsistent (270,177 MWh vs 1,425,480 GJ); Siltronic Portland site status not re-verified for 2025 (report says four production locations in Asia, Germany and the US).
